blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s lead impeachment lawyer has questioned the prosecution panel for suddenly withdrawing three of four Articles of Impeachment. She noted that this comes after the public and senator-judges have already heard the evidence presented. After the prosecution made the announcement, defense counsel Sheila Sison made a manifestation during the trial on Tuesday. Sison sarcastically expressed appreciation to lead public prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro for formalizing the withdrawal of three articles, just after the government had spent funds on the trial and participants had expended their energy. “We thank the lead prosecutor for the candor today, […]...
